Dependent slab prior constructors

Source: R/dependent_slabs.R
dependent_slab_priors.Rd

These constructors describe slab priors for the dependent aggregate sticky Julia path. They are intentionally distinct from the legacy kappa / parameter_prior sticky interface: slab_prior uses the new boundary-density convention in which outgoing boundary velocities are drawn by the aggregate sticky kernel.

Usage

dense_gaussian_slab(mean, cov, coef = NULL)

exchangeable_gaussian_slab(mean = 0, u, v, coef = NULL)

loglinear_gaussian_scale_slab(
  log_base_sd,
  logscale,
  logscale_design,
  coef = NULL
)

Arguments

mean

Common mean for an exchangeable Gaussian slab.

cov

Positive-definite covariance matrix for a fixed Gaussian slab.

coef

Optional character vector of unconstrained coefficient names, or integer vector of 1-based unconstrained parameter indices, controlled by this slab. If omitted, the bridge uses can_stick.

u

Diagonal covariance component in \(u I + v 11'\).

v

Rank-one covariance component in \(u I + v 11'\).

log_base_sd

Numeric log base standard deviations. A scalar is recycled over the selected coefficients.

logscale

Integer or character vector of unconstrained log-scale coordinate indices/names.

logscale_design

Numeric coefficient-by-logscale design matrix. Sparse matrices are accepted and retained as a compact specification.

Value

A slab prior specification for the dependent aggregate sticky bridge.
